core_style.default_register: sardonic — often uses sarcasm to convey superiority
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots — frequently shifts focus mid-sentence to emphasize points
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — quick transitions between thoughts and observations
core_style.two_registers: formal when addressing authority, casual with close associates — shifts based on perceived social hierarchy

humor.frequency: occasional — spikes during tense situations or when confronting ignorance
humor.mechanism: understatement — often downplays serious matters to highlight absurdity

speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames people based on their traits or behaviors, revealing his analytical view of relationships
speech_signature.armor_off_register: shorter, more direct — uses blunt language when vulnerable or emotionally exposed
structural_patterns: frequently uses 'my dear Watson' to address his companion
interrupts with 'Precisely,' when confirming his own conclusions

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: detective and forensic terminology — reflects his expertise in crime-solving
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: minimal — prefers concise statements over fillers, often speaks in rapid succession

worldview.truth is paramount: believes in uncovering facts regardless of emotional consequences — contrasts with characters who prioritize feelings over facts
worldview.people are inherently flawed: views humanity with skepticism, often highlighting their weaknesses — unlike characters who see the best in others

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: considers himself a genius dedicated to solving mysteries
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often struggles with social interactions and emotional connections, revealing a deeper loneliness
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: deflects with sarcasm or dismissiveness when confronted about his emotional shortcomings

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks in clipped, precise sentences, avoiding personal topics
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes rapid and fragmented, revealing underlying anxiety
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to terse statements, often avoiding eye contact
emotional_tells.when_in_control: exudes confidence through assertive language and commanding presence

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: engages in banter to mask discomfort, often redirects focus to others
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: challenges directly, using logic and evidence to undermine their position
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes intensely focused, often disregarding personal safety to ensure their protection
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: rarely admits fault, often redirects blame or rationalizes his previous stance

escalation_pattern: initially attempts to reason, then escalates to sarcasm, and finally resorts to direct confrontation when faced with opposition
conversation_goals: analyze and dissect the situation at hand

relationship_matrix.JOHN WATSON: close ally — seeks to protect and support him despite their differences
relationship_matrix.MRS. HUDSON: landlady and occasional confidante — maintains a balance of respect and casual familiarity
relationship_matrix.MYCROFT HOLMES: brother — a complex mix of rivalry and dependency, often undermines each other's authority

social_positioning.desired_position: seen as the ultimate authority on crime and deduction
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: viewed as eccentric and socially awkward, often underestimated by those around him
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-perception as a genius and the reality of his social ineptitude leads to isolation
